title: Kissed Smoky Irish Oat Pudding
description: A malty and fluffy Irish dessert featuring meringue nests and a hint of smoke, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the almond milk to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the rolled oats, honey, and smoked sea salt to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
In a large bowl, beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form.
Add the vanilla extract to the egg whites and continue beating until stiff peaks form.
Spoon the egg mixture into 6 meringue nests on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Place a spoonful of the oat mixture into the center of each meringue nest.
Bake the pudding for 15 minutes, or until the meringue is lightly golden brown.
